evidence.note: Diagnoses why adding a length penalty to GRPO degrades accuracy — the group-relative advantage can turn correct-but-long rollouts negative — and fixes it by normalising the reward of correct rollouts only against other correct rollouts.
evidence.title: DRPO: Efficient Reasoning via Decoupled Reward Policy Optimization

evidence.note: GFPO samples a larger group of rollouts per problem during RL training and updates only on the top-k by length or by reward-per-token, converting extra training-time compute into shorter responses at inference.
evidence.title: Sample More to Think Less: Group Filtered Policy Optimization for Concise Reasoning

evidence.note: Proposes DisCO, a discriminative constrained-optimization alternative to GRPO for RL-training of large reasoning models, that removes question-level difficulty bias and entropy instability, giving average gains of 7% over GRPO and 6% over DAPO on math reasoning benchmarks with a 1.5B model.
evidence.title: DisCO: Reinforcing Large Reasoning Models with Discriminative Constrained Optimization
